name: La Fonda on the Plaza

dates.altered: Interiors by Mary Elizabeth Jane Colter for the Fred Harvey Company after the Atchison, Topeka and Santa Fe Railway bought it in 1925; remodelled and enlarged by John Gaw Meem from 1929 (the style node; the hotel's own timeline names all three designers).
dates.note: Wikipedia prints 'Opening December 30, 1922'; the hotel's timeline says 'The structure that guests enjoy today was built in 1922'; the style node gives 1922.

refs.title: La Fonda on the Plaza - Wikipedia
refs.note: Location '100 E. San Francisco Street'; 'a member of Historic Hotels of America, a program of the National Trust for Historic Preservation, since 1991'.

refs.title: Historic Timeline - La Fonda on the Plaza
refs.note: Owner. 'built in 1922 and features the influence of architects Isaac Rapp, Mary Elizabeth Jane Colter and John Gaw Meem'; a 2014 City of Santa Fe Historic Preservation Division award for the recent renovation.

note: Seeded 4 Sep 2026. No National Register number was found (the article carries none; the search '"La Fonda" Santa Fe hotel 1922 Rapp Meem "National Register" OR "Historic Hotels" OR sah-archipedia' returned the hotel's own pages and travel writing) and no HABS record.
